in_marathi.name: Chittranjan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon-born, Lunar, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chittranjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chittranjan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chitra' meaning moon and 'ranjan' meaning pleasing or attractive. In Hindu mythology, Chittranjan is a divine name associated with the moon god, Chandrama. It is believed that children named Chittranjan are born under the influence of the moon, endowing them with a calm, thoughtful, and wise nature.
